{{move|List of Japanese language Pokémon Journeys home video releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of [[Pokémon Journeys: The Series|Pocket Monsters (2019)]] of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. ==Volume releases== [[Pokémon Journeys: The Series|Pocket Monsters (2019)]] was divided into two sets that were released by [[Shogakukan]] from 2020 to 2023. It contains almost all the [[List of Pokémon Journeys: The Series episodes|152 episodes]] between them, except the [[Pokémon: The Arceus Chronicles|Arceus, the One Called God]] special, which was [[#Special releases|released separately]], and [[JNS05|The Distant Blue Sky]], which was not released on home video. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ===Pocket Monsters=== Pocket Monsters was released by [[Shogakukan]] from 2020 to 2023. It consists of 45 volumes with 136 episodes across them combined. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background:#{{colorschemelight|Galar}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Galar}}" !
